title: Frozen-Core 20L with ±4 nm Outer Perturbation (Round 9 Anchor)
scientific_hypothesis: The central 10 layers (indices 5-14) from the Round 9 optimal candidate contain the critical cavity resonance condition. Restricting outer layer optimization to ±4 nm prevents disruption of this resonance while allowing fine-tuning of input/output coupling and stopband edges.
design_principle: Defective DBR Bandpass Filter with localized optimization. Core layers fixed to empirically optimal values; outer layers treated as matching sections.
proposed_topology: 20-layer alternating stack on Fused Silica. Layers 0-4 and 15-19 optimizable; Layers 5-14 fixed.
manufacturing_considerations: Thickness tolerance ±4 nm on outer layers implies high precision requirement
theory_basis: Defect mode transmittance depends on background refractive index matching
Quarter-wave DBR with Defect Cavity principle
known_risks: ±4 nm bounds may be too restrictive to find global optimum
Fixed core may prevent further stopband improvement
execution_request_english: Design a 20-layer planar multilayer filter on Fused Silica substrate with Air incident medium. Materials: Ta2O5 and SiO2 alternating, starting with Ta2O5 at layer 1. Wavelength range 1300-1800 nm. Optimize for high transmittance at 1550 nm and suppression at 1400-1500 nm and 1600-1700 nm. Fixed thicknesses for layers 6-15 (1-indexed) [indices 5-14 0-indexed]: 206.16, 190.39, 162.13, 148.41, 153.02, 167.58, 185.64, 208.73, 216.53, 227.41 nm. Optimizable thicknesses for layers 1-5 and 16-20 [indices 0-4 and 15-19 0-indexed] with bounds ±4 nm from Round 9 baseline values: Layer 1 (230.77), Layer 2 (231.92), Layer 3 (234.04), Layer 4 (229.19), Layer 5 (225.83), Layer 16 (224.28), Layer 17 (228.35), Layer 18 (216.31), Layer 19 (218.00), Layer 20 (218.22) nm. Use gradient_thickness optimizer. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 1400-1500 nm, 1550-1550 nm, 1600-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmittance at 1550 nm (soft target ≥ 0.95); strong suppression of transmittance in 1400-1500 nm and 1600-1700 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: transmittance in 1400-1500 nm; transmittance in 1600-1700 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layers ≤ 30.
revision_reason: Implementing insight directive to anchor central stack to Round 9 peak values and restrict outer perturbation radii to ±4 nm to remain within linear response zone.
